messages:
PagerDuty Bot: \ud83d\udd14 paging oncall: sudden 5xx/timeouts on api-gateway (us-east). Alert: 5xx_rate > 7% for 2m, timeout_rate > 3% for 2m.
Ravi (oncall SRE): acked. starting investigation.
Diego (gateway): I'm seeing a lot of 429s from quota-check followed by 504 upstream timeouts. sample log: `quota_check tenant=acme -> 429 QuotaExceeded` then `upstream timeout to inference-svc`.
Nora (quota): pulling quota-service metrics... interesting: several tenants show cap=0 in the service cache. that's not right.
Ravi (oncall SRE): how did cap=0 happen? rollout today?
CI/CD Bot: deploy: quota-service configmap updated by deploy/ci-pipeline at 2026-03-15T10:02:45Z (change: quota-template -> v5).
Nora (quota): looking at the template diff: the new Helm template uses `{{ .Values.default_cap | default "${DEFAULT_CAP}" }}`. during templating the env var expansion failed and produced an empty string which the renderer turned into 0 for numeric caps. Repro steps: helm template --values -> produced `max_tokens: ` (empty) and our loader coerces to 0.
Diego (gateway): so gateway asks quota-service, gets cap=0 -> returns 429 -> clients (and our SDKs) retry -> bursts saturate inference and cause timeouts/504s. Classic cascade.
Elena (support): customers calling in. I have 7 enterprise customers on the list with >15% failure rate 09:58-10:05 UTC. Posting on status page now.
Ravi (oncall SRE): mitigation plan: (A) disable new config rollout (B) set emergency override caps for affected tenants to previous known-good values (C) add temporary gateway retry budget to limit retries (D) add circuit-breaker on quota-service cache misses.
Nora (quota): A: disabling rollout: `kubectl -n infra set env deploy/ci-pipeline DISABLE_QUOTA_TEMPLATE=true`
CI/CD Bot: env change applied by Nora at 10:08:12Z
Nora (quota): B: applying override patch to quota-service configmap with fallback caps. `kubectl apply -f emergency-override-us-east.yaml` content: `tenants: {acme: 1000, demo: 500, default: 500}`
Ravi (oncall SRE): before we apply B, Diego, can you put gateway-level retry budget to limit to 2 retries per source IP and add a 500ms jitter to reduce thundering?
Diego (gateway): adding retry-budget rule now: `gatewayctl policy add --name retry-budget --max-retries 2 --scope ip --jitter 500ms`
Diego (gateway): policy applied. seeing retry rate drop by ~60% within 45s.
Nora (quota): applying emergency override now. Patch applied and propagated to us-east cached nodes.
Ravi (oncall SRE): monitoring metrics... 429s dropping, 5xx back to baseline in us-east. good.
Elena (support): status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2512356789 — incident window 10:02-10:12 UTC, mitigation in progress. informing impacted accounts via DM.
Ravi (oncall SRE): root cause identified: Helm template change in quota template allowed env expansion to produce empty values that became zeros. The CI pipeline didn't run the template validation check because the pre-deploy linter was skipped for this PR.
Nora (quota): immediate next steps: revert template change and add explicit schema validation in the helm linter to fail on empty numeric fields. will open PR with tests.
Ravi (oncall SRE): long-term mitigations: (1) add canary validation that deploys quota templates to a staging shard and runs synthetic traffic that asserts caps > threshold (2) add runtime sanity check in quota-service to reject caps < 10% of previous value unless manual approval (3) implement retry budget and token-bucket at gateway to prevent client-driven cascades.
Diego (gateway): logging and traces saved: s3://redwood-incidents/2512356789/gateway-logs.tar.gz, jaeger trace link: https://jaeger.redwood.ai/trace/abc123. config diffs in PR #4890.
Elena (support): creating follow-up customer outreach plan and credit matrix for SLA breaches.
CI/CD Bot: deploy rollback queued: rollback of quota-template v5 -> v4 initiated by Nora at 10:18:30Z.
Nora (quota): rollback applied, quota-service reverted to v4. verifying caches now.
Ravi (oncall SRE): confirmation: cache state shows expected caps restored. monitoring for 20m before close.
Elena (support): interim message to customers posted. will send targeted DMs to top impacted accounts.
PagerDuty Bot: incident acknowledged cleared by Ravi at 10:31:50 UTC.
Ravi (oncall SRE): handing off to postmortem channel. will publish a detailed incident report and link PRs for the rollout checks. good job team.
Elena (support): filing incident ticket for billing adjustments for impacted customers.
Nora (quota): PR opened: #4891 - helm-linter: add numeric-field-nonempty rule + unit tests.
Ravi (oncall SRE): closing slack thread. full postmortem ETA 48h. logs archived to s3://redwood-incidents/2512356789/postmortem.tar.gz. thanks all.
